description: Address v2 review findings: separate rate-limit buckets per endpoint, add express.json body size limit, unref the cleanup interval, and handle 429 responses in AiAssistant.tsx client-side.
steps: 1. In server.ts: Create separate rate-limit Maps for /api/ai-chat and /api/voice/tts endpoints (chatRateLimitStore and ttsRateLimitStore). Update isRateLimited to accept an endpoint identifier parameter.
2. In server.ts: Add body size limit to express.json: app.use(express.json({ limit: '10kb' }))
3. In server.ts: Call .unref() on the setInterval timer to prevent it from blocking graceful shutdown.
4. In src/components/AiAssistant.tsx: Check response.ok before parsing. If status is 429, show a user-friendly 'Too many requests, please try again in a minute' message instead of a random fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting uses separate Maps per endpoint (chatRateLimitStore and ttsRateLimitStore)
setInterval cleanup timer has .unref() called on it
AiAssistant.tsx checks response.ok and shows a specific message for 429 status
findings: All 4 v2 review issues addressed. Separate Maps (chatRateLimitStore, ttsRateLimitStore) isolate rate-limit budgets per endpoint. express.json({ limit: '10kb' }) rejects oversized payloads at the HTTP layer. cleanupInterval.unref() allows graceful Node shutdown. AiAssistant.tsx now checks response.ok and shows a bilingual rate-limit message for 429 responses. Lint passes cleanly.
